subject: Enable upload of integration test outputs (#426)
reason: The change modifies only CI workflow files (.github/workflows/*), build.sh argument parsing, and ci/build_ubuntu.sh to upload unit/integration test outputs as GitHub artifacts and enable core dumps in CI containers. No source file of the valkey-search module is touched, so the loaded module's runtime behavior — commands, replies, indexing, replication, persistence — is identical on both builds. There is no server-reachable behavior change to test, so no scenario is needed.
